title: Pre-order conflict over 50/50 and daycare
summary: Sana argued 50/50 was rough on the children and regretted supporting it; daycare dispute also framed as best-interest/co-parenting issue
key_quote: doing a 2-2-3 schedule because of your insisted 50-50 schedule has been very rough on the children
legal_question: Whether later attacks on 50/50 are genuinely new
notes: Strong pre-4/15/21 baseline showing same core custody criticism already existed.

title: Spring Break framed as fairness to parent
summary: Sana framed holiday possession around what each parent got; Eric argued for following the mediated schedule and reducing conflict around children
key_quote: You need to start being fair instead of just thinking about yourself
legal_question: Whether later possession complaints reflect changed conditions or longstanding worldview
notes: Useful contrast but Eric's tone is often hostile and should not be overfeatured.

title: Post-cutoff daycare/Thursday possession dispute
summary: Immediately after 4/15/21 the parties continued an already-existing dispute over Thursday possession and daycare timing rather than beginning a new category of conflict
key_quote: You need to follow the above agreement as stated in the decree
legal_question: Whether this is continuity rather than material change
notes: Important temporal bridge across the 4/15/21 cutoff.

title: Summer Wed-Thu exchange dispute and flexibility proposals
summary: Eric proposed altered exchange times or suspending summer Wed-Thu exchanges for consistency before defaulting to the decree; later June 24 exchange escalated into police/custody accusations
key_quote: Best agreement would be to suspend the We/Th transfers during periods during the summer, that would create a lot more consistency for the kids
legal_question: Whether conduct shows flexibility before enforcement and who escalated exchange conflict
notes: Strong for flexibility theme; June 24 facts are disputed and should be presented neutrally.

title: Scout campout swaps and possession leverage
summary: Eric repeatedly proposed swaps so Rayan could attend campouts; Sana's agreement became tied to additional scheduling concessions and was changed at the last minute
key_quote: I think this is the best way to ensure Rayan gets to go to both campouts
legal_question: Whether possession negotiations were used in ways that interfered with child activities
notes: Good pattern evidence; preserve full chronology because both parties negotiated hard over equal days.

title: Adult topics shown/discussed with Rayan
summary: Eric objected that Sana showed Rayan old adult text messages and discussed drugs/smell; Sana later accused Eric of marijuana exposure
key_quote: Friendly reminder that it's not appropriate to discuss adult topics with children
legal_question: Whether a parent involved the child in adult conflict or inappropriate allegations
notes: Potentially important theme but factual support beyond the parties' competing statements should be sought.

title: Aleena lunch pickup dispute
summary: Sana characterized Eric taking Aleena from daycare for lunch/visit during her possession as an order violation; Eric rejected the legal framing and wanted parenting concerns separated from legal accusations
key_quote: You are welcome to have lunch with Aleena at her school but not take her out during my posession time
legal_question: Whether ordinary parent-child contact was framed primarily through possession rights
notes: Useful for parent-time accounting theme; Eric's replies include harsh language and should be contextualized.

title: Rayan lunch one-on-one offer
summary: Eric explicitly offered Sana one-on-one lunch time with Rayan and asked whether she preferred him not to attend
key_quote: should I come too, or would you like your one-on-one time?
legal_question: Whether Eric supports the children's relationship and direct time with Sana
notes: Clean affirmative evidence of supporting mother-child relationship.

title: Rayan all-A report card
summary: Both parents positively acknowledged Rayan's all-A report card
key_quote: I'm very proud of Rayan for getting All A's
legal_question: Balanced evidence of normal cooperative moments
notes: Keep positive/cooperative events so index is not advocacy-only.

title: Rayan stomach illness communication
summary: Eric notified Sana Rayan was sick
pre_or_post_2021_04_15: updated improvement and school-return criteria; parties also coordinated dentist rescheduling
column20: Whether medical communication pattern supports or contradicts neglect/exclusion allegations
column22: Mostly ordinary parenting; useful as counterexample to categorical medical-neglect claims.

title: Rayan requests KRK transportation change
summary: Rayan expressed interest in switching after-school transportation from Campus Kids to KRK; Eric arranged the change and framed it as giving Rayan a voice; Sana objected that educational decisions required joint agreement and repeatedly worked to revert the change
key_quote: Rayan has expressed interest again to transfer from campus kids to krk
legal_question: How much weight should be given to child's preference versus joint-decision requirements
notes: Potentially important recurring pattern: child's stated preference becomes adult/legal control dispute. Need external school records and decree terms before drawing legal conclusion.

title: Rayan allegedly blamed for parents' conflict
summary: Eric reported that after Rayan called him Sana picked a fight and then told Rayan it was his fault the parents fought because he called
key_quote: you picked a fight then told him it was his fault we fought because he called me
legal_question: Whether child was made responsible for parental conflict
notes: Only Eric's contemporaneous report in TP currently; needs corroboration before treating as established fact.

title: Eric proposes recurring co-parenting lunch and family dinner
summary: Eric proposed private recurring co-parenting lunches and later a family dinner requested by Rayan to reduce conflict around the children; Sana declined pending resolution of substantive disagreements
key_quote: The more Rayan and Aleena can see us cooperating together, the better
legal_question: Whether Eric made affirmative efforts to improve co-parenting and reduce children's exposure to conflict
notes: Strong affirmative cooperation evidence despite Eric's accusatory tone around the proposals.

title: Spring Break return dispute
summary: Parties disputed whether Eric's possession resumed Sunday or Monday; Eric repeatedly requested confirmation and stated he would enforce the decree; Sana said he could file; she ultimately brought the children Sunday evening
key_quote: Feel free to file whatever you think you need to file
legal_question: Whether this was a threatened or actual possession violation and what the decree required
notes: Need decree language verified independently. Useful pattern of litigation posture but Eric's messaging was highly charged.

title: Aleena Spring Break exchange location dispute
summary: Eric offered flexibility but parties disagreed over Walmart versus daycare exchange location; inability to reach each other by phone compounded the dispute and led to delayed transfer
key_quote: if you would like to agree to meet at Kids R Kids at 4, that is ok too
legal_question: Whether rigid/legalistic communication increased otherwise avoidable transfer conflict
notes: Illustrates conflict mechanics more than clean fault. Potential support for idea that schedule itself was workable but interactions created problems.
